scripts.build:android: expo prebuild --platform android --clean --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon --console=plain -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a
scripts.build:ios: expo prebuild --platform ios --clean && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace UAEPassExample.xcworkspace -scheme UAEPassExample -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
